digest.component_or_area: scoped failure fuse over coordinator outcomes
propositions: Endpoint fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted outcomes across at least two distinct tickets
Provider fuse opens only when failures span at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider
Eligible exhausted outcomes are determined by retry budget exhaustion provenance, never by disposition text or physical attempt counts
A matching success outcome resets the consecutive counter for that scope independent of other scopes
Open fuse returns explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata without executing matching remaining plans
Physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, and opaque diagnostics are excluded from the eligible counter
